players.product: AI server ODM: NVIDIA B300 systems built mostly at L10 rack level in Taipei, with board assembly through L6 / L10 / L11 full-rack integration at new Taiwan and Texas sites

quarterly_data.signal: Daxi Manufacturing Center (Taoyuan, Taiwan): NT$4.03Bn investment; opens 3Q26 with revenue starting 4Q26; doubles AI-server system capacity and adds full rack-level integration, with a new dedicated line for proprietary liquid cooling; an important hub of Compal's Taiwan-Vietnam-U.S. delivery network.
quarterly_data.figure: NT$4.03Bn investment; opens 3Q26, revenue from 4Q26; doubles AI-server system capacity

quarterly_data.signal: AI-cloud wins listed in the deck across three regions: May-26 an EU sovereign AI cloud (liquid-cooled GPU), May-26 a US GPU neocloud on NVIDIA HGX B300, Jun-26 a Japan-APAC cloud for live inference; Jul-26 a full liquid-cooling CDU portfolio (in-rack L2L CDU, L2A sidecar, in-row L2L CDU). At Computex 2026 Compal showcased full-stack AI data centers - rack-scale systems on NVIDIA Vera Rubin, liquid cooling and HVDC power. The company positions itself as a Tier-1 supplier for advanced architectures.

1H26 results: net sales NT$439,598 million (+16% YoY); gross margin 4.9% (1H25: 5.5%); operating profit NT$5,499 million (+3%); net income to parent NT$5,100 million (+91%); EPS NT$1.18. 2Q26 inventories NT$111,644 million (1Q26: NT$99,647 million).
quarterly_data.figure: 1H26 net sales NT$439,598 million (+16% YoY); EPS NT$1.18
